title: Index of global real economic activity (Kilian index), based on dry cargo ocean freight rates
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas (index by Lutz Kilian)
licence: Public research data of the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas; cite Kilian (2009, 2019)
units: percent deviation of real (US CPI deflated) freight rates from a linear trend
limitations: A real, detrended index of dry cargo single-voyage freight rates, not the Baltic Dry Index; the project converts it back to nominal terms with the US CPI and estimates the trend on the years where both series exist (2011 onward).
The trend and the scaling are re-estimated by the publisher with each update, so past values can change slightly.
